title: Mechanism of natural antioxidants regulating advanced glycosylation end products of Maillard reaction.
authors: Jia, Wei; Guo, Aiai; Zhang, Rong; Shi, Lin
one_liner_zh: 该文综述天然抗氧化剂调控美拉德反应晚期糖基化终产物的机制，涉及蛋白糖基化但无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: According to the investigation of Food and Drug Administration 2021, one hundred and twenty-six potentially harmful substances are produced by Maillard reaction. Discovery of advanced glycosylation end products (AGEs) of Maillard reaction has impacted public's understanding of the transformation mechanism of Maillard reaction and its impact on health. This review clarifies the reaction kinetics of Nepsilon-(carboxymethyl) lysine, the representative substance of AGEs in food simulation system, and key nodes of forming AGEs. Inhibition mechanism of natural antioxidants is expounded from the aspects of biological activity, inhibition of protein glycosylation and its structure-activity relationship. Transformation mechanism is mainly to scavenge free radicals, capture active carbonyl compounds and protect protein glycosylation sites. Nutraceutical polyphenols can regulate the expression of RAEG, effectively promote KEAP1-Nrf2 pathway, inhibit MAPK and TGF-beta pathway. Inhibition mechanism and novel application in foods processing in the future should be further studied in future.
abstract_zh: 根据美国食品药品监督管理局2021年的调查，美拉德反应产生了一百二十六种潜在有害物质。美拉德反应晚期糖基化终末产物（AGEs）的发现影响了公众对美拉德反应转化机制及其对健康影响的理解。本综述阐明了食品模拟系统中AGEs代表性物质Nepsilon-(羧甲基)赖氨酸的反应动力学，以及形成AGEs的关键节点。从生物活性、抑制蛋白质糖基化及其构效关系方面阐述了天然抗氧化剂的抑制机制。转化机制主要是清除自由基、捕获活性羰基化合物和保护蛋白质糖基化位点。营养性多酚能够调节RAEG的表达，有效促进KEAP1-Nrf2通路，抑制MAPK和TGF-beta通路。未来应进一步研究抑制机制及其在食品加工中的新型应用。
